definitions.lean_statements_pure_mathlib: Comparator challenge files that import only Mathlib and in which a textual scan detects no local vocabulary declarations: a reader checks the theorem statement against Mathlib vocabulary alone. Files with no local vocabulary that import OpenAI's own modules are excluded.
definitions.lean_vocabulary: Local vocabulary declarations detected by a textual scan of a Comparator challenge file: definitions, abbreviations, structures, classes, inductive types, instances, notation, macros and axioms. Theorem and lemma declarations, including the target theorem, are excluded. A proof that Comparator accepts proves the statement as phrased in this vocabulary, so each item is something a reader checks means what the paper means.
definitions.manuscripts_with_lean: Current manuscripts listed as accompanying papers in a family's Lean scope note (lean/docs/NNN.md) that links at least one Comparator statement.
definitions.internal_citation_edges: Bibliography entries in a manuscript's TeX sources that point to another manuscript in the collection (an openai/math preprint link or an OAI: key), counted once per citing and cited manuscript.
definitions.external_works_cited: References outside the collection grouped automatically by DOI, then arXiv id, then full normalised title; a title-only reference joins the one DOI or arXiv record with the same full title (and year, when both give one), keeping the merged keys as aliases in works.json. No person has audited the grouping, so a work can still be split or merged by mistake.
definitions.external_citations: Resolved bibliography keys in current manuscripts' TeX sources that point outside the collection, each manuscript and key counted once.
definitions.most_cited_outside_works: Outside works ranked by how many current manuscripts cite them (each manuscript counted once).
definitions.most_cited_inside_collection: Current manuscripts ranked by how many other current manuscripts in the collection cite them, with whether each has an accompanying Lean statement.
definitions.scope_coverage: A draft classification of how each Comparator challenge file relates to its paper's headline result: it states the headline theorem, part of it, a consequence, a weaker form or a supporting result, or the note leaves it unclear. An AI agent made it from OpenAI's scope note for the family (lean/docs/<family>.md), quoting the note on every row (curated/scope_coverage.json). No person has reviewed it.
definitions.lean_count_reconciliation: Published counts of how much of the release has Lean, side by side: families whose Lean notes link a Comparator statement; families and papers in the sources list of OpenAI's lean/formalization.yaml; OpenAI's own reported share; and counts from other public sources. Each measures a different thing.

review_queue.rule: Points per reason, highest first: a configuration with no theorem target 100; definition holes 90 plus one per hole; unclear draft scope 85; a draft scope reading needing a specialist 80; a target theorem shared with another file 70; an axiom in the challenge 60; no local vocabulary but OpenAI imports 50; 100 or more local declarations 20 plus one per hundred (capped); a family with no full-headline statement 5. Ties go alphabetically. The order allocates reading; it is no verdict.

definitions.model_statement_definitions: Proposition-valued definitions (def or abbrev ending in `: Prop`) in a project's Model.lean, where projects state their papers' claims as Lean propositions.
definitions.manuscript_theorems: Theorems or lemmas whose name contains 'manuscript', the naming some projects use for proofs of their papers' claims.
definitions.manuscript_theorems_checked_by_comparato: Manuscript theorems whose full name occurs directly in a Comparator configuration's theorem_names list. A configured proof can use many other theorems, so this is a name match, not a measure of what Comparator checks.
definitions.projects_with_model_file: Distinct projects OAI/<area>/<project>/ containing at least one file named Model.lean; model_files counts the files.
definitions.lean_projects: Folders OAI/<area>/<project>/ in OpenAI's Lean library that contain Lean files.
definitions.scan: Textual scan of lean/OAI at the pinned commit; nothing is built, so a listed theorem exists in the source but is not thereby checked.
